content.text: 0 seconds of 0 secondsVolume 0%Loading ad00:2500:0001:28 NEED TO KNOW The 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards will crown a new set of winners at the awards ceremony held at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles on Thursday, March 26PEOPLE has the complete list of winnersThe ceremony will air live at 8 p.m. ET on FOX The 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards are recognizing music's top artists. Ludacris hosted the annual awards show will air live on FOX and held at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles on Thursday, March 26. Performers at the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards included Alex Warren, John Mellencamp, Kehlani, Lainey Wilson, Ludacris, Raye, TLC, Salt-N-Pepa and En Vogue. John Mellencamp will be honored with the Icon Award, while Miley Cyrus will receive the Innovator Award. Check out all of PEOPLE's iHeartRadio Music Awards coverage here. Alex Warren at the iHeartRadio Music Awards on March 26, 2026. Amy Sussman/Getty See the complete list of 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards winners below.
